summary: H World Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement dated August 5, 2026, setting the audit committee meeting date of August 17, 2026, for approval of Q2 2026 results, with a conference call to follow. It also advises that the board is considering a cash dividend, with declaration, if approved, by board resolution around August 17, 2026. No dividend amount, record date, or payment date is given. This is a routine scheduling and earnings announcement notice, not a special situation. The possible dividend is merely under consideration with no terms stated, so no special-situation category applies.
